task: K4 Day 9 - Multi-Agent E-commerce Dispute Resolution

model_selection_rationale.customer: Pure CSV lookup — extract customer_unique_id and related orders by join, no LLM needed
model_selection_rationale.order_product: Pure CSV join — items/sellers/products/categories extracted deterministically
model_selection_rationale.payment: Pure arithmetic — reconcile_payment() handles all totals with 0.10 BRL tolerance
model_selection_rationale.delivery: Pure datetime math — compute_delivery_variance() and compute_handoff_variances()
model_selection_rationale.policy: Deterministic rule engine — EC_POLICY_V2 priority order implemented as Python conditionals; LLM hallucination risk eliminated
model_selection_rationale.verifier: gpt-4o-mini for schema correction — handles edge cases not caught by structural validation

design_principle: Do not trust the customer claim — join and verify all facts from CSV before applying policy
